export.createdAtFingerprintRole: display metadata only; excluded from record fingerprints

privacy: entirely local; no export or restore payload is sent to a server

compatibilityAndIntegrity.checksum: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON for each record and the complete records array
compatibilityAndIntegrity.versionPolicy: exact major format version required; compatible minor versions may use an explicit migration plan
compatibilityAndIntegrity.migrationPolicy: migration is preview-only until every source and destination schema validates; no network access
compatibilityAndIntegrity.duplicateRecordIds: reject unless previewed deterministic replace_matching_record_ids is selected
compatibilityAndIntegrity.atomicRollback: all stores commit atomically; any error causes complete rollback
compatibilityAndIntegrity.archivePolicy: ZIP and other archive containers are unsupported and rejected
